name: Twitch
description: Popular live streams in the menu, Twitch channels in search, live chat, and streams that play in sync for everyone.
requires: Internet access from the server to twitch.tv. No Twitch account needed.

settings.label: Your channels (shown first when they are live)
settings.help: Twitch names separated by commas, e.g. "lofigirl, xqc".

settings.label: Extra row for a language
settings.help: Shows a row of popular streams in that language, e.g. "sv". Empty = no such row.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: The client ID Twitch's website uses. Only change it if Twitch changes something.
